en.bdb: In the court of the emperor all are known as servants.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਜੁਹਾਰੀਆ ਸਭ ਸੈ ਹਥੀਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: niv niv karan juhaareeaa sabh sai hatheeaare|

en.bdb: Armed well, they bow most humbly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਜਲਸ ਬਹਿ ਬਾਫਾਇਂਦੇ ਬੋਲ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਭਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: majalas beh baafai(n)dhe bol bolan bhaare|

en.bdb: In the social and cultural gatherings they boast and brag.
They have their elephants decorated and in the streets and bazars they roam with their horses dancing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਇਆਂ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਜੋਧ ਭਜਣਹਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: ran vich piaa(n) jaaneean jodh bhajanahaare|

en.bdb: But only in the battle field is known who is a valiant fighter and who is to take to his heels.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਸਾਂਗਿ ਸਿਞਾਪਨਿ ਸਨਮੁਖਾ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਹਤਿਆਰੇ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: tiau saa(n)g sin(j)aapan sanamukhaa bemukh hatiaare ||19||

en.bdb: Similar are the apostates, the assassins who disguised as close to the Lord remain around, but ultimately are identified.
